newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Corporation Bank board to meet on Oct 30.
newsitem.headline: India's Corporation Bank board to meet on Oct 30.

text.p: The board of Corporation Bank will meet on October 30 to consider a revision in lending rates, its chairman said on Friday.

K.R.Ramamoorthy, chairman and managing director of the state-run bank headquartered in the southern city of Mangalore, told Reuters by telephone that the board will consider a downward revision in lending rate.
The move follows initiatives by the Reserve Bank of India to boost liquidity and trigger an interest cut.
